wing_name: AI Agent Turn, Then Something Set to Start (Behaviour)
description: An AI agent worked on a request, and within 30 minutes a service was installed, an autostart entry or scheduled task registered, or a Defender exclusion added. The agent's own record lists the commands it ran in that turn; the persistence comes from the registry, the service list and the event logs.
proves: Something was set to start on its own, or protection was lowered, while an AI agent was working
author: Crow-Eye Team
